Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

services.description: Every transport the agent knows about, advertised or not. A kind absent from this array has never been configured — distinct from one present with `enabled: false`.

ServiceKind.description: Which transport a task is acting on. This is the discriminator: it selects which member of `config` is meaningful, and a payload naming one kind with another's config is malformed rather than merely ignored.
ServiceKind.title: ServiceKind

ServiceState.description: What the agent currently advertises for one service. `enabled` is the only member every kind carries; the rest are kind-specific and absent when they do not apply. Note that `enabled: false` and an absent entry are different: the first says the agent knows about this transport and is not advertising it, the second says it has never been configured.

drainEndsAt.description: RFC 3339 instant at which a scheduled drain completes. Present only while a `didcomm` mediator is draining — see `vta/services/drain/list`.

enabled.description: Whether the agent currently advertises this transport in its DID document.

mediatorDid.description: The mediator this transport routes through. Present for `didcomm` and `tsp`.

url.description: The advertised endpoint. Present for `rest` and `webauthn`.

ServiceState.title: ServiceState
